machines.name: Biovore
machines.title: Artillery Organism
machines.description: These living artillery pieces nurture a clutch of Spore Mines within their bodies. After anchoring themselves to the ground with their chitinous spurs, the creatures fire their living ammunition in high arcs into the midst of the foe where it detonates with sudden violence.

abilities.name: Bio-Minefield
abilities.template:
Targets an enemy on the battlefield. If there are 3 or more Spore Mines on the battlefield, all Spore Mines immediately take a turn, moving towards the target, if possible. Otherwise, summon 3 Spore Mines in free hexes adjacent to the target. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage with Floating Death.

Initial cooldown: 2 rounds. 
Cost: 1 munition.
abilities.description:
Targets an enemy on the battlefield. If there are 3 or more Spore Mines on the battlefield, all Spore Mines immediately take a turn, moving towards the target, if possible. Otherwise, summon 3 Spore Mines in free hexes adjacent to the target. Spore Mines have 2610 Health and deal 1x 7178-8614 Toxic Damage with Floating Death.

Initial cooldown: 2 rounds. 
Cost: 1 munition.

abilities.name: Spore Mine Launcher
abilities.template: Summons a Spore Mine onto a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage damage with Floating Death.

machines.name: Exorcist
machines.title: Artillery Tank
machines.description: Every flurry of notes performed by the Exorcist's artillerist loads and targets thrice-blessed rocket volleys to bombard the enemy. More than artillery tanks, Exorcists are mobile shrines to the magnificence of the Emperor that project inspirational battle canticles.

abilities.template:
Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, it deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with ranged attacks against enemies on Fire hexes. Affected Adepta Sororitas units deal additional damage with all attacks instead. The Exorcist then deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies in the longest uninterrupted straight line originating from the targeted friendly unit.

Initial cooldown: 1 round. 
Cost: 1 munition.

This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.

Each enemy unit hit has a {[chance]}% chance to increase the Crit Chance and Crit Damage of friendly units with Act of Faith as if a friendly Imperial unit had killed an enemy unit.

machines.name: Forgefiend

machines.description: Forgefiends are fused with enormous rotary cannons and ancient artefact-ordnance perverted to vomit ectoplasma from the beasts’ own innards. With such weaponry they scythe down masses of enemy troops and blast glowing craters into the toughest opposition.

The Forgefiend's Crit Chance for both its abilities is increased by {[extraCritChance]}% for each time Daemonic Ordnance is used during a battle, but after the Forgefiend causes 3 or more critical hits during its turn, it cannot cause any critical hits anymore for the remainder of the battle.

Initial cooldown: 1 round.

machines.name: Reanimator
